title: Shakey the Robot
summary: SRI began the Shakey research program in 1966. Shakey combined mobile robotics with perception, reasoning, planning and route-finding in a single research system developed at SRI's Artificial Intelligence Center.
significance: A documented early embodied artificial-intelligence system that integrated multiple AI capabilities in a mobile robot.

geography.note: SRI's institutional history identifies Shakey as a research subject of SRI's Artificial Intelligence Center; geography is limited to the institution's California research context and is not presented as a separate public-launch location.

verification.note: SRI's first-party institutional history states that Shakey was the subject of its Artificial Intelligence Center research from 1966 to 1972 and describes its perception, reasoning, planning, route-finding and object-rearrangement capabilities. The record is intentionally stored at year precision because the reviewed evidence supports the research start year, not a separately verified exact system-birth day.

sources.title: The man, the myth, the legend: Meet Shakey the robot, the world’s first AI-based robot

candidateMeta.admissionReason: The 1966 research-start year and system capabilities are supported by SRI first-party institutional evidence. Canonical admission should preserve year precision and avoid converting SRI's historical page date into an unsupported exact system-birth date.
candidateMeta.nextStep: Review canonical chronology around ELIZA 1966 and later historical records, then admit Shakey with year precision and chronology-only traversal until any stronger relationship is separately sourced.
